title: AI Retrofit for an Existing Chatbot — Keep What Works, AI Catches the Rest

sections.label: 1 · KEEP WHAT ALREADY WORKS
sections.note: Nothing gets ripped out. Your existing flows keep handling everything they already handle correctly, and they answer first. AI only sees the messages your bot currently falls over on, which is the cheapest way to add it and the easiest to roll back.

sections.label: 2 · AI PICKS UP THE REST
sections.note: Answers come from your own help docs and past transcripts, not from general knowledge, so the bot cannot start telling customers things that are not true for you. The model itself is a swappable piece rather than a hardcoded dependency.

sections.label: 3 · CHECK BEFORE IT SENDS
sections.note: Every AI answer is scored for confidence and checked for a supporting source. No source means it is not an answer, it is a handoff. This is the single difference between a bot customers trust and one they learn to bypass.

sections.label: 4 · IT GETS BETTER EVERY WEEK
sections.note: Every question the AI could not answer is logged as a content gap. That list is what you feed back into the knowledge base, so coverage improves from real customer questions instead of guesses.

input_sample.user_message: if I cancel halfway through the year do I get the rest of my months back or is it just gone

output_sample.route: AI handled it (existing bot had fallen back to its menu)
output_sample.reply: You'll get a prorated refund for the unused months, back to the original payment method, usually within 5 business days. Nothing is forfeited. Want me to start that for you?
